description: This file defines the ResourceService interface for managing resources within the Thingsboard platform, including methods for CRUD operations, data export/import, resource usage updates, and resource retrieval based on various filters.

classes.name: ResourceService
classes.description: Interface defining resource management operations such as CRUD, export/import, and resource usage updates within the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: saveResource
methods.description: Saves a resource, with optional validation.

methods.name: findResourceByTenantIdAndKey
methods.description: Finds a resource by tenant ID, resource type, and resource key.

methods.name: findResourceById
methods.description: Finds a resource by tenant ID and resource ID.

methods.name: getResourceData
methods.description: Retrieves resource data as byte array.

methods.name: getResourceDataInfo
methods.description: Gets resource data info for a given resource.

methods.name: exportResource
methods.description: Exports resource data.

methods.name: exportResources
methods.description: Exports multiple resources.

methods.name: toResource
methods.description: Converts export data to resource object.

methods.name: importResources
methods.description: Imports resources from export data.

methods.name: findResourceInfoById
methods.description: Finds resource info by ID.

methods.name: findResourceInfoByTenantIdAndKey
methods.description: Finds resource info by tenant ID, resource type, and key.

methods.name: findAllTenantResources
methods.description: Retrieves all tenant resources with pagination.

methods.name: findResourceInfoByIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds resource info by ID.

methods.name: findAllTenantResourcesByTenantId
methods.description: Finds tenant resources filtered by tenant ID.

methods.name: findTenantResourcesByTenantId
methods.description: Finds tenant resources with specific filter and pagination.

methods.name: findTenantResourcesByResourceTypeAndObjectIds
methods.description: Finds tenant resources by resource type and object IDs.

methods.name: findTenantResourcesByResourceTypeAndPageLink
methods.description: Finds tenant resources by resource type with pagination.

methods.name: deleteResource
methods.description: Deletes a resource, with optional force.

methods.name: deleteResourcesByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes all resources for a tenant.

methods.name: sumDataSizeByTenantId
methods.description: Calculates total data size for a tenant.

methods.name: calculateEtag
methods.description: Calculates an ETag for resource data.

methods.name: findSystemOrTenantResourceByEtag
methods.description: Finds a resource by ETag.

methods.name: updateResourcesUsage
methods.description: Updates resource usage based on dashboard or widget details.

methods.name: getUsedResources
methods.description: Retrieves resources used by a dashboard or widget.

methods.name: createOrUpdateSystemResource
methods.description: Creates or updates a system resource.

methods.name: findSystemOrTenantResourcesByIds
methods.description: Finds resources by a list of resource IDs.
